div.head: I Cn 12
div.ab: And leohtgesceot þriwa on geare: ærest on Easteræfen healfpenigwurð wexes æt ælcere híde ⁊ eft on Ealra halgena mæssan eallswa mycel [⁊ eft to þæm sanctan Marian clænsunge ealswa].
And leohtgesceot þriwa on geara: arest on Easteræfen healfpeningwurð wexes æt ælcere hide ⁊ eft to Ealra halgena mæssan ealswa mycel.
Et fiat ter in anno simbolum luminis: primum in uigilia Pasche obolata cerę de omni hida (carruca); in festo Omnium sanctorum tantundem, tertio tantundem in festo sancte Marię candelarum.

And leohtgesceot þriwa on geare: ærest on Easteræfen healfpenigwurð wexes æt ælcere híde ⁊ eft on Ealra halgena mæssan eallswa mycel [⁊ eft to þæm (æfene) sanctan Marian clænsunge ealswa]. [Ld, and margin of G in 16th cent. hand.]

And light dues [shall be paid] three times a year: first a halfpennyworth of wax from every hide on Easter Eve, and as much afterwards at the feast of All Saints, [and as much afterwards at the Feast of the Purification of St Mary].

Und Lichtschoss dreimal im Jahre: von jeder Hufe einen Halbpfennigwerth an Wachs zuerst am Ostervorabend und wieder am (vor A) Aller Heiligenfest [1. Nov.] ebenso viel (und wiederum zu Mariae Reinigung [2. Febr. Vorabend] ebenso viel. Ld Versionen).

And light-dues three times a year: half a penny's worth of wax from every hide, first on Easter Eve and again at (before, A) All Saints [1 November] as much (and again at the Purification of Mary [eve of 2 February] as much, Ld and the Latin versions).
div.note: The bracketed third payment was added in the margin of G in the 16th century from Ld (Liebermann would supply ‘æfene’ after ‘þæm’). Liebermann compares VI Atr 19.
